purpose: Determine whether two GSHHG-conforming terrestrial multi-island study frames are ecologically interpretable and independent by publicly documented study methods, region and taxonomic group; not source-to-target movement or observed colonization.
decision_gates: Are both study regions genuinely in separate archipelagos rather than two datasets from one sampling design?
Does each dataset study the same organism(s) and compatible sampling events across separate islands?
Does the source metadata support site-level annual detection inference rather than re-encounters or aggregate site summaries?
Does the record establish independent geological origin? If not, leave oceanic-versus-continental origin unknown.
nonclaims: No taxon-site-year 0-to-1 results in studies 373 or 375
No confirmed propagule dispersal or demographic rescue
This source cannot by itself estimate a universal two-archipelago island law
